about: kb-v2 C8 evaluation questions, written and committed BEFORE any C8 run; not to be edited after results. Sets: 'gold' = the 26 questions in scripts/kb/compare_kb_v2.py (referenced, not copied); 'live' = questions as asked in the live checks (docs/kb_v2_live_check_2026-10-06.md, docs/kb_v2_live_check_2026-10-07_b7.md); 'unseen' = 40 new questions. 'expected' = accepted [law title, section] pairs (any one counts). Expected sections were checked to EXIST in the records except where 'note' says the record is missing or mislabelled; those count as failures.
